jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿

Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead and execute clinical Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) modeling projects within multidisciplinary systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and drug development teams, driving model-informed decision making across development programs.
- Additionally, you will develop, qualify, apply, and communicate fit-for-purpose QSP models that integrate non-clinical, translational, biomarker, and clinical data to address critical scientific and development questions.
- You will also translate biological and pharmacological knowledge into quantitative model structures, assumptions, and simulations, generating actionable insights while clearly communicating model limitations, uncertainties, and their potential impact.
- Furthermore, you will define and drive QSP modeling strategies aligned with project objectives, delivering scientifically robust analyses and interpretations to support clinical development decisions.
- You will provide independent advice on complex mechanistic modeling challenges and represent QSP expertise in cross-functional scientific, technical, and strategic discussions.
- Beyond this, you will provide scientific leadership and guidance throughout model development, qualification, application, and communication activities while fostering collaboration across internal teams and external partners.
- Finally, you will drive innovation, standardization, and digitalization in mechanistic modeling and simulation by evaluating, developing, and implementing novel methodologies, tools, and technologies, while overseeing external modeling activities to ensure scientific excellence and strategic alignment.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, clinical pharmacology, computational biology, bioengineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
- Several years of hands-on professional experience in QSP modeling in the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory authorities, or relevant academic research
- In-depth knowledge of mechanistic modeling in clinical drug development, including model development, calibration, qualification, simulation, sensitivity analysis, and interpretation of results
- Experience with R and/or relevant QSP modeling platforms such as MATLAB/SimBiology, Julia, OSP Suite, or comparable tools; experience with statistical methods for analysis of nonclinical and clinical data is beneficial
- Strong ability to communicate complex modeling concepts, assumptions, uncertainties, and decision impact clearly to multidisciplinary audiences
- Proven collaboration skills in international, multidisciplinary teams and ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including experts, CROs, vendors, and leadership teams
- Fluent in written and spoken English

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until Sept 30, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to Sept 11, 2026, are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid-September till early October
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of late October

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Imagine starting your day with a strategic alignment call with senior leadership, followed by a deep-dive workshop on a high-impact transformation initiative. You’ll spend your afternoon synthesizing insights from cross-functional teams, preparing a board-level briefing, and closing the day by aligning with external partners on a future-facing innovation pilot. 

You will lead and orchestrate some of our most critical and confidential strategic initiatives—ranging from M&A considerations and digital transformation to ESG acceleration and organizational redesign. Your work will directly influence the trajectory of our business, shaping how we deliver value to customers, drive sustainability, and future-proof our operations. You’ll be embedded in a high-performing, diverse, and globally connected team that thrives on trust, curiosity, and bold thinking. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leading end-to-end execution of strategic projects with high visibility and executive sponsorship
* Translating complex challenges into actionable workstreams and measurable outcomes
* Facilitating cross-functional collaboration across businesses, regions, and external partners
* Preparing executive-level presentations and decision documents for the Board and C-suite
* Identifying risks and opportunities early, and proactively steering mitigation strategies
* Acting as a thought partner to senior leaders, challenging assumptions and driving clarity

What You Bring

* Masters degree in Engineering, Business or other relevant subject areas, as well as longstanding professional experience
* A strategic mindset with a strong analytical foundation—ideally from top-tier consulting or corporate strategy roles
* Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects in dynamic environments
* Exceptional communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels
* A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience under pressure, as well as a collaborative spirit and the ability to thrive in ambiguity
* Passion for innovation, transformation, and making a tangible impact
* A collaborative spirit and the ability to thrive in ambiguity 

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

jobs.description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have been striving to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers and businesses to grow, discover, and create.

IntelliJ IDEA revolutionized the Java development tool market back in 2001, becoming the first IDE to offer automated code refactoring. It continues to drive innovation in software development, making thousands of programmers more productive every day. In addition to Java, IntelliJ IDEA includes various development tools for other prominent languages such as Ruby, Groovy, Scala, Python, JavaScript, Objective-C, PHP, and Kotlin.

About the team

The IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate team is responsible for supporting a wide range of enterprise frameworks, data-access stacks, and application servers in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. This includes technologies such as Spring (including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, and others), Jakarta EE, Quarkus, Micronaut, various reactive and data-access libraries, and popular application servers like Tomcat, WildFly, and Jetty. We ensure that developers can easily create, configure, run, debug, and observe their backend applications directly from the IDE. As part of the Ultimate QA group, you’ll work across different areas of the product – frameworks, HTTP client, persistence tooling, and application servers – and collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other QA teams to deliver a smooth end-to-end experience for JVM backend developers.

We’re now looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join the IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate QA team and help ensure the quality of a product that our customers and software engineers around the world rely on daily. You’ll work alongside QA engineers to design and set up our automation process for end-to-end tests, as well as implement and automate test scenarios that catch issues before they reach our users.

What you’ll do

Core responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and maintain multi-platform and environmental (Linux, Windows, macOS, Docker, WSL) automated test scenarios.
- Expand test coverage for new and existing functionality.
- Debug and troubleshoot test failures.
- Improve existing automation based on team feedback and reduce test flakiness.
- Track quality metrics, including testing coverage, failure rate, and flakiness.
- Contribute to frameworks and tools with product-specific extensions as needed.
- Help the team monitor test execution results and investigate failures.
- Participate in release quality assessments.
- Collaborate with QA and developers to define test strategies.
- Do manual QA activities when needed.
- Participate in the test documentation creation.
- Improve domain-specific test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines within your team’s scope.
- Share automation best practices with the team.
- Work with the tooling team to adopt new frameworks and practices.

What we’re looking for

Required skills:

- Proven experience in test automation.
- Solid programming skills in Kotlin/Java.
- Experience with test frameworks like JUnit or TestNG.
- Familiarity with build tools, like Maven and Gradle.
- An understanding of software testing principles and methodologies.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (TeamCity or similar).
- Experience with reporting tools (Allure or others).
- Version control experience (Git).
- Proficiency in spoken and written English.
- Responsibility, self-discipline, and self-learning skills.
- Strong teamwork skills.
- The ability to work independently, creatively, and on your own initiative.

Nice to have:

- Experience testing developer tools, IDEs, and desktop applications.
- Familiarity with JVM Frameworks (Spring or Jakarta) and databases.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

We build Qodana to bring the intelligence of JetBrains IDEs directly into the CI/CD pipeline, helping engineering teams spot security flaws, license issues, and bugs before they ever reach production. As AI-assisted coding grows, the need for deep, static code analysis is more critical than ever.

In this role, you’ll join our Qodana Core team to expand our static analysis engine and design new algorithms for complex, inter-procedural code analysis. You will have direct ownership over how we configure and orchestrate these analyses across different environments. You’ll collaborate closely with other JetBrains compiler and IDE teams, directly influencing how development teams worldwide maintain code quality and adopt AI safely.

Day to day, you will:

- Design and implement new static analysis checks, rules, and inter-procedural analysis algorithms.
- Extend Qodana’s capabilities in critical areas like license compliance, security, and vulnerability detection.
- Optimize how code analysis runs, configure execution paths, and orchestrate performance based on project context.
- Build and refine CI/CD integrations to make Qodana easy to adopt across different development workflows.
- Collaborate with compiler and IDE teams across JetBrains to share insights and align analysis engines.
- Take ownership of features from early concept to release, gathering feedback and iterating to make them better.

What you’ll bring

- A deep curiosity about code structure, compilers, and how static analysis works.
- A proactive mindset, not waiting for permission to fix a broken process or improve a system.
- Strong collaboration skills and a readiness to support your technical ideas with clear, logical reasoning.
- Comfort working in a distributed team across different countries and time zones.
- A focus on quality over quick fixes, valuing long-term maintainability in your work.
- Experience with developer tooling, static analysis, application security, or LLM-based applications would be a plus. Familiarity with languages and ecosystems beyond the JVM – such as C++, Rust, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, .NET, or Go – would also be valuable.

What you’ll need

- Deep, practical knowledge of JVM development (such as Kotlin or Java).
- Experience designing and implementing complex algorithms or handling performance-critical backend architectures.
- Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members globally.

What success looks like

- **First 3 months:** You will get familiar with the Qodana codebase and the IntelliJ Platform architecture, delivering your first set of analysis rules and integrations.
- **First 6 months:** You will take full ownership of specific analysis features, collaborating with neighboring teams to design robust solutions for complex codebases.
- **Long term:** You will help shape the technical direction of Qodana Core, continuously raising the bar for static analysis performance and developer experience.

Why join JetBrains?

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.
